uutiset.t: Goldman’s Trivedi Says ‘Dollar Still Has Some Fight in It’
uutiset.s: Kamakshya Trivedi, chief FX and emerging markets strategist at Goldman Sachs, offers his outlook for the US dollar and examines the factors that can most impact the currency. He speaks on “Bloomberg Brief.” (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Amazon Barges of Crop Trader Amaggi Swap Diesel for Biofuels to Curb Fuel Costs
uutiset.s: Crop trader Amaggi Exportacao e Importacao Ltda is switching to biodiesel to move soybeans through a key export corridor in the Amazon, using Brazil’s abundant biofuels as a shield from rising fossil-fuel prices.

uutiset.t: Ukraine Farm Failures Loom as War Drains Financial Buffers, Top Trader Says
uutiset.s: Ukraine’s agricultural sector faces a growing risk of insolvencies as escalating attacks in the Black Sea and tightening access to financing put pressure on farmers, according to one of the country’s top crop traders.

uutiset.t: Coca-Cola Bottler Hit by EU Probe Into Abuse of Market Power
uutiset.s: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Plc, a bottler of soft drinks including Coke, has been hit by a formal European Union antitrust investigation over fears it may have illegally carved up EU markets.

uutiset.t: Trump Suggests Resumption of Iran Strikes Next Year If Talks Fail
uutiset.s: US President Donald Trump indicated to Fox News that if talks fail to yield a diplomatic resolution, he might resume the war on Iran next year. Trump accused the Islamic Republic of dragging out the indirect talks underway. Stuart Livingstone-Wallace reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloombe

uutiset.t: Five Charts Unpack One of the Worst Weeks for Stocks in Decades
uutiset.s: Wall Street’s unwind wiped more than $5 trillion from the S&P 500 last week, exposing just how much of the market’s fortunes rest on its biggest stocks and the AI investment boom.

uutiset.t: Margin Calls Soared 200-Fold in Taiwan as Traders Fled AI Bets
uutiset.s: Julia Lee, a stockbroker in Taiwan, spent so much time making margin calls last week that she decided to add a human touch. She sent empathetic messages to suffering traders, saying she was there to help them ride out the storm.

uutiset.t: Is The AI Selloff A Buying Opportunity?
uutiset.s: Bloomberg's Anna Edwards and Guy Johnson speak to Bernard Ahkong, Dymon Asia Capital Partner and Portfolio Manager on the back of last week's AI selloff on Bloomberg's "The Opening Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: America is Betting on Ostrich Again
uutiset.s: For nearly 150 years, the ostrich has been an object of American fascination. It set off agricultural gold rushes, its plumes crowned the hats of the Gilded Age’s most fashionable women, and it’s been touted as the next great American meat. uutiset.t: Morgan Stanley’s Wilson Says Buying Opportunity Too Good to Miss
uutiset.s: A week that saw both the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average enter correction territory has delivered investors a buying opportunity that’s too good to miss, according to Morgan Stanley strategists.

uutiset.t: Bets on Bonds From Oil-Rich Kazakhstan, Nigeria Pay Off for Finland’s Aktia
uutiset.s: Betting on bonds from two major oil-producing emerging markets has paid off handsomely for Finland’s Aktia Asset Management, which plans to stick with the trade amid persistent US-Iran tensions.

uutiset.t: India Banking Cash Turns to Deficit for First Time Since June
uutiset.s: India’s banking system liquidity slipped into deficit for the first time in about five months, as recent tax outflows reduced cash with lenders.

uutiset.t: Libyan Oil Pipeline Reopens, Restoring Output at Biggest Field
uutiset.s: A Libyan pipeline carrying crude from the country’s biggest oil field reopened after a brief disruption, restoring a significant proportion of the OPEC member’s output.

uutiset.t: South Africa’s Woolworths, Momentum Face Pay Challenges
uutiset.s: Three of South Africa’s best-known companies will face challenges on issues including their pay policies and the independence of some of their directors at annual general meetings over the next week.

uutiset.t: Indian Stocks Briefly Erase 2026 Losses on Record Foreign Buying
uutiset.s: Indian shares briefly overcame their losses for the year before turning sharply lower on Monday even as local shares continue to see a powerful return of foreign money with the unraveling of the AI trade reviving demand for overlooked markets.
